title: Belém Bridges: Bidirectional Dijkstra Finds Fast Routes
description: Bidirectional Dijkstra starts search from both the start and the destination, expanding the lowest-cost paths outward on each side. When the two frontiers meet, it stitches the partial routes into the shortest path—often reaching the goal much sooner than a one-direction search. Watch how Belém’s streets become two synchronized waves of optimal travel.
